responsibility: Defines custom RTL operand predicates used by the IQ2000 machine description to decide which operands match particular instruction patterns. These predicates classify immediates, registers, simple memory references, comparison operators, call targets, move sources, and other target-specific operand forms such as large constants and power-of-two immediates, encapsulating the backend’s operand admissibility rules that iq2000.md patterns rely on during recognition and reload.
